customer.label: Customer
customer.description: The customer buys a measurable change to enterprise performance — not a collection of systems.

partner.label: Partner
partner.description: The partner monetises discovery, integration, managed operations and value assurance.

cisco.label: Cisco + ecosystem
cisco.description: Capabilities are selected only after a value hypothesis and delivery dependencies are understood.

story.title: The hidden opportunity
story.headline: Connected machines alone do not guarantee throughput.
story.explanation: Technology data is useful. But the business question remains unanswered when each function sees only its own system.
story.presenterNotes: Ask the audience which dashboards they already have. Contrast product insight with enterprise decision quality. Avoid calling current tools broken. Industry-specific context: Traditional smart-factory demos showcase machine telemetry, but executive priorities are throughput and resilience.
story.transition: Next, connect this to start at the board.

lensTalkingPoints.customer: Decision owner and measurable change: Plant director.
lensTalkingPoints.cisco: Capability test: Cisco industrial networking — subject to architecture fit.

story.title: Start at the board
story.headline: Begin with output, unit economics and plant resilience.
story.explanation: Begin with strategic demand: decisions and outcomes the leadership team will fund.
story.presenterNotes: Ask for three board objectives and one measurable commitment. Where relevant separate revenue, operating costs, risk and sustainability obligations. Industry-specific context: A plant board wants more good units, lower cost per unit and safe operations.
story.transition: Next, connect this to follow value across functions.

lensTalkingPoints.customer: Decision owner and measurable change: Plant director.
lensTalkingPoints.cisco: Capability test: Cisco industrial networking — subject to architecture fit.

story.title: Follow value across functions
story.headline: Follow losses across production, maintenance and finance.
story.explanation: An outcome is shared across functions; costs, owners and evidence are distributed.
story.presenterNotes: Invite stakeholders to identify who controls actions versus who carries cost or benefit. Accessibility, EHS and privacy can change the solution. Industry-specific context: Plant, maintenance, quality, EHS and finance must share the measured definition of loss.
story.transition: Next, connect this to build the value twin.

lensTalkingPoints.customer: Decision owner and measurable change: Production / Quality.
lensTalkingPoints.cisco: Capability test: Cisco industrial networking — subject to architecture fit.

story.title: Build the Value Twin
story.headline: Model production value before a full digital twin.
story.explanation: A Value Twin is a semantic model of customer decisions, signals, assumptions and value — before a full operational digital twin.
story.presenterNotes: Explain the conceptual Value Twin is a linked decision graph: it does NOT need live BMS or a rendered BIM model to begin. Source claims remain provisional. Industry-specific context: The Value Twin connects business constraints to existing OT and enterprise evidence before a full spatial twin.
story.transition: Next, connect this to reason across signals.

lensTalkingPoints.customer: Decision owner and measurable change: Production / Quality.
lensTalkingPoints.cisco: Capability test: Cisco security for IT/OT — subject to architecture fit.

story.title: Reason across signals
story.headline: Correlate OT and enterprise evidence responsibly.
story.explanation: Reason over evidence from multiple domains; discover patterns while marking uncertainty and testing causality.
story.presenterNotes: Discuss correlation versus causation. Confirm data access, quality, time alignment, weather, seasonality, shifts, comparable sites and privacy. Industry-specific context: Micro-stops plus maintenance backlog may indicate a recoverable constraint — subject to plant validation.
story.transition: Next, connect this to test a business hypothesis.

lensTalkingPoints.customer: Decision owner and measurable change: Maintenance.
lensTalkingPoints.cisco: Capability test: Cisco security for IT/OT — subject to architecture fit.

story.title: Test a business hypothesis
story.headline: Test a safe, financially qualified intervention.
story.explanation: Prioritise measurable interventions, baseline the outcome and design a risk-controlled pilot.
story.presenterNotes: Choose one hypothesis. Agree baseline, test design, owner, benefit formula, risk controls, investment threshold and success/failure triggers. Industry-specific context: A production trial, change controls and measurement plan establish the viable intervention.
story.transition: Next, connect this to orchestrate the ecosystem.

lensTalkingPoints.customer: Decision owner and measurable change: Maintenance.
lensTalkingPoints.cisco: Capability test: Cisco security for IT/OT — subject to architecture fit.

story.title: Orchestrate the ecosystem
story.headline: Orchestrate industrial, security and reliability expertise.
story.explanation: Only now select vendor capabilities, partners, services and commercial models necessary to deliver value.
story.presenterNotes: Do not present the Cisco portfolio as the whole solution. Show OT, integrators, FM/industry experts and partner recurring revenue responsibilities. Industry-specific context: Cisco, OEMs, OT integrators and reliability specialists each contribute defined capabilities.
story.transition: Next, connect this to prove, learn and expand.

lensTalkingPoints.customer: Decision owner and measurable change: EHS / Sustainability.
lensTalkingPoints.cisco: Capability test: Splunk / observability — subject to architecture fit.

story.title: Prove, learn and expand
story.headline: Prove performance under real production conditions.
story.explanation: Operate, measure against the counterfactual, report realised value and feed learning into the next opportunity.
story.presenterNotes: Close the loop: evidence-backed impact, governance, operational ownership, changes in assumptions, and scaling into adjacent sites or value streams. Industry-specific context: Verify uplift under representative production conditions before multi-plant deployment.
story.transition: Return to a new discovery conversation or choose a different industry pack.

lensTalkingPoints.customer: Decision owner and measurable change: EHS / Sustainability.
lensTalkingPoints.cisco: Capability test: Splunk / observability — subject to architecture fit.
